title: Falsehood and Impossibility Are Different Directions in an AI's Representation of Language
abstract: arXiv:2608.12852v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language can describe states of affairs that are false and states of affairs that could not be the case at all. Whether an AI model internally distinguishes these failures remains unclear. I report an exploratory activation study of the multimodal open-weight model Gemma 3 4B IT using 85 prompts from 17 philosophical families and a topic-matched modality set of 15 topics, each expressed as a truth, contingent falsehood, improbable claim, semantic anomaly, and necessary falsehood. In its answers, the model conflates contingent falsehood with contradiction, labeling 12 of 15 false statements "contradiction." Its activations show a different pattern. A linear truth probe separates impossible from true statements (AUC 0.93) but not impossible from false statements (AUC 0.20). An impossibility probe evaluated on held-out topic families separates necessary from contingent falsehood at AUC 1.00, peaking at layer 15 with balanced accuracy 0.97

translated_title: 虚假与不可能在AI语言表征中是不同方向
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12852v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：语言可以描述虚假的事态，也可以描述根本不可能发生的事态。目前尚不清楚AI模型是否在内部区分这些失败类型。我报告了一项对多模态开放权重模型Gemma 3 4B IT的探索性激活研究，使用了来自17个哲学家族的85个提示和一个主题匹配的15个主题模态集，每个主题以真命题、偶然虚假、不可能主张、语义异常和必然虚假的形式表达。在回答中，模型将偶然虚假与矛盾混为一谈，将15个虚假陈述中的12个标记为“矛盾”。其激活模式则显示出不同特征。线性真值探针能区分不可能与真命题（AUC 0.93），但无法区分不可能与虚假命题（AUC 0.20）。在保留的主题家族上评估的不可能性探针能以AUC 1.00区分必然虚假与偶然虚假，在第15层达到峰值，平衡准确率为0.97。
tldr: 该研究发现AI模型在语言输出中混淆虚假与不可能，但其内部激活模式能清晰区分两者，表明虚假与不可能在AI语言表征中是不同的方向。
en_tdlr: This study finds that while an AI model conflates falsehood with impossibility in its outputs, its internal activation patterns can clearly distinguish them, indicating that falsehood and impossibility are different directions in an AI's representation of language.
